chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from Al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from one of his companions, from Aban ibn Uthman ibn 'Isa, from 'Isa ibn 'Abdullah, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When you wake up in the morning, say: 'O Allah! I seek refuge with You from the evil of what You created, spread, and released in Your lands and among Your servants. O Allah! I ask You by Your Majesty, Your Beauty, Your Forbearance, and Your Generosity, such and such.'

key_terms.كَذَا وَ كَذَا: Such and such (indicating specific requests follow)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended morning supplication to seek refuge from the evil of creation?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi, this supplication reflects the Shia tradition of daily spiritual protection through specific morning adhkar, emphasizing reliance on Allah's attributes of Majesty (Jalal) and Beauty (Jamal). It serves as a practical framework for believers to seek refuge from the evils inherent in creation and to invoke divine grace through established theological concepts.
